response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and some systems-level D-lang experience, but the role requires deep hardware expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance architecture, and hardware-software co-design. There is no evidence of chip architecture, GPU/SIMD/MIMD work, deep-learning workload optimization, or performance modeling at the hardware level, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite the candidate's seniority in software engineering.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, exceeding the Bachelor's + 8 years threshold
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Demonstrated initiative through open-source projects, workshops, and technical talks
concerns: No SoC, IP modeling, or hardware architecture experience whatsoever
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU workload analysis background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, far from principal-level performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI/DL workload or GPU architecture background
Long tenure and some low-latency systems work
